acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a rain shower system, when integrated into a luxury bathroom renovation, is part of the larger project schedule. For a spa-inspired primary bathroom, AKN Design Group provides a clear project timeline upfront, managing every step from concept to completion.
